summary: Gather l3_interfaces with eos_facts gather_network_resources, feed ansible_network_resources back into eos_l3_interfaces, and assert not changed to verify config hasn't drifted.
questions: How do I check that network config hasn't changed?
Can I push gathered facts back into a resource module?

answer_card.title: Verify config hasn't drifted
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- arista.eos.eos_facts:
    gather_subset: min
    gather_network_resources: l3_interfaces

- arista.eos.eos_l3_interfaces:
    config: "{{ ansible_network_resources['l3_interfaces'] }}"
  register: result

- assert:
    that: not result.changed
```
